name: GRCh38-v1
reference: GRCh38, chr-prefixed contig names (1000 Genomes analysis set GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla, or any build sharing its primary and unplaced contigs; the chrEBV dosage region and two DJ sink intervals are on the analysis set's chrEBV and hs38d1 decoy contigs and drop out where those are missing)

sinks_learned_from.rule: 10-kb placement bins holding >= 1e-5 of a class's reads and >= 25 reads in any scan, padded by 1 kb

TEL.samples: 372 whole-file scans of the 1000 Genomes 30x cohort (NYGC pipeline), 2026-09-22; the positional classes' sinks above are unchanged
TEL.rule: ngsdose sinks --classes TEL: 10-kb placement bins holding >= 1e-5 of the class's reads and >= 25 reads in any scan, padded by 1 kb, clipped to the contig
TEL.held_out_check: sets learned from 40 of the scans captured a median of 0.998 over the other 332, and at least 0.9942-0.9959 in each, depending on the 40 drawn (0.9948 for the first 40, eleven draws); 0.9987 is the median in-sample capture of the 372-scan set. Across the 1,748 cohort scans counted by 2026-09-25 the shipped set captures min 0.9939 (HG02756), 1st percentile 0.9968, median 0.9987. Scored with ngsdose.sinks.capture, which counts a 10-kb placement bin only when all of it lies inside a sink; capture_over_the_372 was scored by the bin's start, and the full-bin rule gives the same min and a median of 0.99869
TEL.why: telomeric reads are not dispersed: 92% lie within 25 kb of a chromosome end, 60% in chr5:10,000-20,000; fetch mode measures TEL when telomere.k31.panel.tsv.gz is loaded

sinks_history.change: the telomeric repeat's intervals were added on 2026-09-22; the rows of the classes listed are unchanged (the file without the TEL rows hashes to this value), so fetch counts that record this hash are complete for them and lack only the TEL class
